title: Order Employees by Salary
description:
Return every employee ordered by **salary descending** (highest paid first).

**Table: employees**

| Column | Type |
|--------|------|
| id | INT |
| name | VARCHAR |
| salary | INT |

Output columns: `name`, `salary`.
schema_sql: CREATE TABLE employees (id INT, name VARCHAR, salary INT); INSERT INTO employees VALUES (1, 'Alice', 70000), (2, 'Bob', 55000), (3, 'Carol', 90000);
solution_sql: SELECT name, salary FROM employees ORDER BY salary DESC

test_cases.description: Three rows ordered Carol, Alice, Bob

hints: DESC sorts from largest to smallest.
explanation: `ORDER BY salary DESC` sorts the result set so the highest salary appears first. Order is part of the contract for this problem.
